title: vignea × germanica
intro: Vignea × germanica, commonly known as German Chamomile, is a flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. It is used as a medicinal herb to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and soothe digestive issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of German Chamomile include acting as a sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent, which helps to calm the mind and body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions.
